Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: icp-filing
Version: 0.0.1

The ICP Filing Guide skill bundle is a purely informational tool designed to help users navigate the Chinese website registration process. The core logic in scripts/icp.sh simply formats user queries into structured prompts for the AI agent, and there are no signs of malicious execution, data exfiltration, or harmful instructions in SKILL.md or the shell script.

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low-risk: it provides Chinese-language ICP filing guidance and includes a small local shell helper that echoes templates. Before installing or running: (1) review any outputs before sharing them externally (the script will echo whatever you pass as input), (2) be aware the author string references bytesagain.com though no homepage is provided (verify source if that matters to you), and (3) do not pass sensitive credentials or secrets as input to the script because it will print them to stdout.
